description:
Send an SMS or iMessage from one of your agent's phone numbers, or react to an existing message. The tool has two modes, so which inputs are required depends on the mode:
- Send: give a recipient (to_number) and a sender (agent_id, from_number, or number_id), plus body and/or media. The agent must have a phone number attached; number_id or from_number picks which one when it has several.
- React: set reaction and react_to_message_id (iMessage only) to tapback or emoji-react to a message. Pass no send fields (recipient, sender, body/media, or send options); those are rejected.
iMessage extras (ignored on SMS): reply_to_message_id threads a reply under an earlier message, and send_style adds an expressive screen/bubble effect.
Returns the sent message (id, status, channel, from/to numbers), or the applied reaction.

agent_id.description: The agent ID to send a message from (must have a phone number attached). Optional with from_number or number_id; omit for reactions.

body.description: The message text to send (may be empty when sending media only)

from_number.description: Exact number to send a message from in E.164 format (alternative to number_id). Omit for reactions.

media_url.description: Link (URL) to a single image or media file to attach to the message.

media_urls.description: Multiple media links (URLs) to attach, delivered as an image carousel on iMessage.

number_id.description: ID of the specific number to send from (from list_numbers). Use when the agent has more than one number; omit for reactions.

react_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of a message to react to. Set together with `reaction`.

reaction.description: iMessage only. Tapback or single emoji applied to react_to_message_id: one of love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, question, or a single emoji (e.g. '🔥'). When set, this reacts instead of sending a message.

reply_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of an earlier message to reply to inline (threaded reply)

send_style.description: An expressive screen or bubble effect played when the message arrives (iMessage only; ignored on SMS). One of: celebration, fireworks, lasers, love, confetti, balloons, spotlight, echo, invisible, gentle, loud, slam.

to_number.description: Recipient: a phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234), a US short code, or a group ID (grp_...) to post into an iMessage group chat. Required when sending a message (not needed for a reaction).

name: send_message

outputSchema.description: The sent message, or the applied reaction when reacting.

channel.description: Channel used: sms or imessage, or null.

from_number.description: Number the message was sent from.

id.description: The sent message's ID (or the reaction's ID).

message_id.description: Message the reaction was applied to (reaction mode only).

reply_parent_unresolved.description: True if the reply parent could not be threaded.

reply_to_message_id.description: Message this was threaded under, or null.

title: Send Message
